children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 21, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Suraj Estate Developers shares surged 13.04% to ₹217.35, trading above their 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day simple moving averages of ₹192.28, ₹194.88, ₹206.06 and ₹216.35, respectively. The stock’s current price is also marginally above its long-term 200-day SMA, indicating sustained buying momentum.

Presstonic Engineering shares gained 10.46% to ₹35.90. The stock is trading above its 30-day SMA of ₹32.50, 50-day SMA of ₹30.10 and 150-day SMA of ₹35.88, but remains below its 200-day SMA of ₹41.23. The sharp rise has pushed the stock marginally above its 150-day moving average.

Kay Cee Energy & Infra shares rose 8.03% to ₹86. The stock is trading above its 30-day and 50-day SMAs of ₹79.61 and ₹83.62, respectively, but remains below its 150-day and 200-day SMAs of ₹102.53 and ₹112.22. The latest gains have lifted the stock above its near-term moving averages, while it continues to trade below its longer-term averages.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Oracle Financial Services Software shares fell 5.94% to ₹11,131, slipping below its 30-day and 50-day simple moving averages of ₹11,833.73 and ₹11,666.56, respectively. However, the stock continues to trade above its 150-day and 200-day SMAs of ₹9,543.55 and ₹9,109.10.

TechD Cybersecurity shares declined 2.82% to ₹549, trading below all four key moving averages. The stock is below its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day SMAs of ₹564.91, ₹583.57, ₹556.18 and ₹570.14, respectively, indicating weakness across both short- and long-term trends.

GTPL Hathway shares dropped 2.74% to ₹54.59, remaining below its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day SMAs of ₹56.13, ₹58.14, ₹62.55 and ₹69.88, respectively. The stock’s current price is below all major moving averages, pointing to continued selling pressure.

Several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying interest in the market. Notable names that hit new high included ACME Solar, Jyoti CNC Auto, Action Construction, Welspun Corp, Laurus Labs, Aegis Vopak, PVR INOX, Welspun Living and Aurobindo Pharm.
Peria Karamalai Tea and Produce Company, ESDS Software Solution, Nimbus Projects among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Suraj Estate Developers, Presstonic Engineering, Kay Cee Energy rise up to 13% on sheer momentum
